summary: Neighborhood Intelligence, Inc. (formerly Bed Bath & Beyond, Inc.) filed an 8-K reporting a corporate name change to Neighborhood Intelligence, Inc., effective August 14, 2026, via a Delaware Certificate of Amendment. The name change required no stockholder vote and did not affect stockholder rights. Concurrently, the company voluntarily transferred its NYSE common stock and warrant listings to Nasdaq, where trading commences August 17, 2026, under tickers NXH and BBBYW. The filing also includes amended bylaws. No acquisition, tender, or other special-situation event occurred; this is a routine corporate action.
